announcement.title: 🎨 Landing Page Maker v1.0.3
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.0.3

  • Choose whether to keep contents when deleting a page section or layer folder. Available in both editors, with undo support.
  • Selecting a grouped layer highlights its members across folders in both editors. Collapsed folders containing members are highlighted too.
  • Supplied setting names and labels now follow Foundry's interface language. Existing pages and reusable parts also get the correction, while custom names and saved values are preserved.
